lessons.title: 远距离通学与自主阅读
lessons.sentence: Although the library stays open late, students who travel long distances often struggle to find enough time for independent reading.

lessons.main: students often struggle to find enough time.
lessons.meaning: 虽然图书馆开放到很晚，但通学路程较长的学生往往仍难以找到足够的时间进行自主阅读。

lessons.title: 仔细比较与隐含规律
lessons.sentence: Researchers who compare the results carefully sometimes notice patterns that would otherwise remain hidden.

targets.m: who compare the results carefully

lessons.main: Researchers sometimes notice patterns.
lessons.meaning: 认真比较研究结果的研究人员，有时会发现原本可能一直隐藏着的规律。
lessons.analysis: 【主干】Researchers notice patterns。【层次】who compare... 修饰 Researchers；that would otherwise remain hidden 修饰 patterns，otherwise 表示如果不仔细观察就可能看不到。【辨析】compare 是定语从句谓语，remain 是另一层定语从句谓语。
distractors: 研究人员认为认真比较会使所有规律消失。
研究人员发现隐藏的规律通常不需要比较结果。
只要发现了规律，研究人员便不再查看任何结果。

roleExplanations.s: Researchers 是外层主语。
roleExplanations.v: notice 是外层谓语；compare 和 remain 均在定语从句内。
roleExplanations.o: patterns 是 notice 的直接宾语，不强制把其后的定语从句一起圈入。
roleExplanations.m: 本句有两处定语从句：who compare... 修饰 Researchers，that would otherwise remain hidden 修饰 patterns。两处都属于正确的定语从句选区。

grammarSupplements.text: who compare the results carefully
grammarSupplements.explanation: who 指研究人员，carefully 修饰 compare。

grammarSupplements.text: that would otherwise remain hidden.
grammarSupplements.explanation: that 指 patterns；would remain 是该从句谓语，hidden 作表语。

o: patterns that would otherwise remain hidden.

lessons.title: 断电后的实验处理

lessons.main: the technician checked the backup system.
lessons.meaning: 电力突然中断时，技术员先检查了备用系统，然后才重新启动实验。

lessons.title: 对证据不足的结论提出质疑
lessons.sentence: The teacher encouraged the students to question conclusions that were not supported by reliable evidence.

targets.m: that were not supported by reliable evidence.

lessons.main: The teacher encouraged the students to question conclusions.
lessons.meaning: 老师鼓励学生质疑那些缺乏可靠证据支持的结论。
lessons.analysis: 【主干】teacher encouraged students。【层次】to question conclusions 是宾语 the students 的补足语，交代鼓励他们做什么；that... 是 conclusions 的定语从句，其中 were not supported 为被动谓语。【辨析】conclusions 是 question 的宾语，不是 encouraged 的宾语。

老师质疑学生能否提供任何可靠证据。
学生鼓励老师不再检查研究结论。

roleExplanations.s: The teacher 是鼓励行为的发出者。

roleExplanations.o: the students 是 encouraged 的宾语。

roleExplanations.m: that were not supported by reliable evidence 修饰 conclusions。

grammarSupplements.text: that were not supported by reliable evidence.

lessons.title: 复查数据后删除图表
lessons.sentence: Having checked the figures twice, the editor removed a chart that might have misled readers.

targets.m: that might have misled readers.

lessons.main: the editor removed a chart.

读者发现编辑故意隐瞒了全部数字。

roleExplanations.v: removed 是主句谓语。
roleExplanations.o: a chart 是被删除的对象。
roleExplanations.m: that might have misled readers 修饰 chart，读者不是主句宾语。

grammarSupplements.text: Having checked the figures twice,

lessons.title: 被质疑的实验带来新成果
lessons.sentence: The experiment, which several experts had initially dismissed, produced results that changed the direction of the project.

targets.m: which several experts had initially dismissed,

lessons.main: The experiment produced results.
lessons.meaning: 这项实验最初曾被几位专家否定，却产生了改变项目方向的结果。
lessons.analysis: 【主干】The experiment produced results。【层次】逗号之间的 which... 是非限制性定语从句，指 experiment；that changed... 限定 results。【辨析】had dismissed 是插入从句的谓语，changed 属于修饰 results 的另一个从句。
distractors: 几位专家最终证明这项实验根本没有产生结果。
实验只改变了专家，而没有影响项目方向。
专家一致决定停止实验，因此项目没有任何变化。

roleExplanations.s: The experiment 是主句主语，插入的 which 从句不改变它。
roleExplanations.v: produced 是主句谓语，表示产生。
roleExplanations.o: results 是产生的结果，后有独立定语从句。
roleExplanations.m: 本句有两处定语从句：which several experts had initially dismissed 是修饰 experiment 的非限制性定语从句；that changed the direction of the project 是修饰 results 的限制性定语从句。选出任意一处完整从句均正确。

grammarSupplements.text: which several experts had initially dismissed,
grammarSupplements.explanation: which 在从句里作 dismissed 的宾语，several experts 是从句主语。

grammarSupplements.text: that changed the direction of the project.

lessons.title: 识别主谓与句子理解
lessons.sentence: If students can identify the main verb, they usually understand the sentence more accurately.

targets.x: If students can identify the main verb,

lessons.main: they usually understand the sentence more accurately.
lessons.meaning: 如果学生能找出主句谓语动词，通常就能更准确地理解整个句子。
lessons.analysis: 【主干】they understand the sentence。【层次】If... 是条件状语从句；can identify 是从句谓语；usually、more accurately 分别表达频率和程度。【辨析】students 是条件从句主语，外层主语是 they。
distractors: 只有记住每一个陌生单词，学生才可能理解句子。
学生找出了主要动词后，通常会把句子理解得更不准确。
如果学生不阅读句子，也能准确掌握其中的语法。

roleExplanations.x: If students can identify the main verb 引出条件，不能当主句宾语。
roleExplanations.s: they 是条件从句后主句的明示主语，指学生。
roleExplanations.v: understand 是主句谓语；identify 只在 If 从句内。
roleExplanations.o: the sentence 是 understand 的宾语。

grammarSupplements.text: If students can identify the main verb,

lessons.title: 新时间表改善放学安排
lessons.sentence: The new timetable not only reduced waiting times but also allowed students to leave school earlier.
lessons.main: The new timetable reduced waiting times and allowed students to leave earlier.
lessons.meaning: 新时间表不仅缩短了等待时间，还让学生能够更早离校。
lessons.analysis: 【主干】The new timetable 同时支配 reduced 与 allowed 两个并列谓语。【层次】reduced 的宾语是 waiting times；allowed 的宾语是 students，to leave... 作 students 的宾语补足语。【辨析】not only ... but also ... 并列谓语，不是两个各有主语的独立分句。

新时间表只改变了课程内容，与等待和放学无关。

lessons.title: 样本选择与调查结论

lessons.title: 简单提问揭示理解偏差
lessons.sentence: A question that seems simple at first can reveal a misunderstanding when students explain how they reached their answers.

targets.m: that seems simple at first

roleExplanations.o: a misunderstanding 是揭示的对象。

lessons.title: 演讲者留时间供听众思考

bundledCorrections.title: 数字平台与形式宾语
bundledCorrections.sentence: The platform, which was introduced to make public services easier to access and was praised by officials who expected it to reduce administrative costs, has instead made it harder for people without reliable internet access to obtain the assistance to which they are entitled.

bundledCorrections.main: The platform has instead made it harder for people ... to obtain the assistance ...
bundledCorrections.meaning: 这个平台原本为了让公共服务更易获取而推出，也曾受到期望它降低行政成本的官员称赞，但它反而让那些没有稳定互联网连接的人更难获得自己本来有权享有的援助。

平台使没有网络的人更容易取得援助，却让拥有网络的人更难获取服务。

bundledCorrections.sentence: That children who performed well on the initial test were more likely to succeed later did not establish that the training itself was effective, since families who volunteered for the programme differed in important ways from those who did not, particularly in the resources with which they could support learning at home.

bundledCorrections.main: That children ... succeeded later did not establish that the training itself was effective.
bundledCorrections.meaning: 最初测试表现好的儿童后来更可能取得成功，并不能证明训练本身有效，因为自愿参加该项目的家庭在重要方面与未参加的家庭有所不同，尤其是其能够用来支持孩子在家学习的资源不同。

由于家庭背景有差异，研究确认训练对儿童的后续表现毫无影响。

roleExplanations.x: since... 引导原因状语从句，说明样本家庭背景不同，尤其是用来支持孩子在家学习的资源不同；with which ... 是嵌套定语从句。

grammarSupplements.text: That children who performed well on the initial test were more likely to succeed later

grammarSupplements.text: who performed well on the initial test

grammarSupplements.text: did not establish

grammarSupplements.text: that the training itself was effective,

grammarSupplements.text: since families who volunteered for the programme differed in important ways from those who did not, particularly in the resources with which they could support learning at home.

grammarSupplements.text: who volunteered for the programme

grammarSupplements.text: in important ways from those who did not,

grammarSupplements.text: with which they could support learning at home.

bundledCorrections.title: 主语从句、插入语与真正的道歉
bundledCorrections.sentence: What makes an apology convincing, according to studies comparing how people respond to different expressions of regret, is not the number of times a speaker says sorry but whether the speaker acknowledges the harm caused and offers to repair it.

targets.p: not the number of times a speaker says sorry but whether the speaker acknowledges the harm caused and offers to repair it.
targets.r: according to studies comparing how people respond to different expressions of regret,
targets.n: comparing how people respond to different expressions of regret,

bundledCorrections.main: What makes an apology convincing is not the number of times ... but whether the speaker acknowledges ... and offers ...
bundledCorrections.meaning: 根据比较人们对不同歉意表达方式反应的研究，真正使道歉有说服力的并不是一个人说了多少次“对不起”，而是这个人是否承认造成的伤害并提出弥补。
distractors: 研究认为，只要道歉者反复表达歉意，就无须承认所造成的伤害。
研究认为道歉是否可信主要取决于表达遗憾的次数，而不是后续的补救行动。
研究得出的结论是，道歉者是否承认伤害并不重要，重要的是对方是否立即原谅。
bundledCorrections.analysis: 外层主语为 What makes an apology convincing 这一主语从句，内部 What 为 makes 的主语，an apology 为宾语，convincing 为宾语补足语。according to... 是夹在主语与系动词 is 中间的插入性介词短语，studies 后 comparing 是现在分词后置定语，how people respond ... 为 comparing 的宾语从句。外层谓语 is；表语是 not ... but whether ... 对举结构：否定“说 sorry 的次数”，强调“是否承认伤害并提出修补”。whether 引导表语成分，从句内 acknowledges 与 offers 是并列谓语，共用 the speaker，the harm caused 中 caused 是过去分词后置定语。

roleExplanations.v: is 是外层主句系动词；makes 只在 What 主语从句内，respond 只在 how 宾语从句内。
roleExplanations.s: What makes an apology convincing 整体作主句主语，不可只选 an apology；中间插入的 according to... 也不属于主语。
roleExplanations.p: not...but... 整体为系动词 is 后的表语，对举否定次数、强调对伤害的承认与补救。
roleExplanations.r: according to 表示“根据……”，其介词宾语是 studies，comparing ... 修饰 studies；这段提供研究依据，并不是独立主句。
roleExplanations.k: convincing 是 What 从句内 make + 宾语 an apology + 宾补结构中的宾补，说明道歉显得怎样。
roleExplanations.n: comparing ... 是现在分词后置定语，修饰 studies；how... 作 comparing 的宾语，含 respond to 固定搭配。

grammarSupplements.text: What makes an apology convincing,
grammarSupplements.explanation: What 在小句中作 makes 的主语，an apology 为 makes 的宾语，convincing 为其宾语补足语；整段作外层主语。

grammarSupplements.text: according to studies comparing how people respond to different expressions of regret,
grammarSupplements.explanation: according to 是复合介词短语，引出研究依据；studies 为介词宾语。插入语隔开外层主语与 is。

grammarSupplements.kind: 现在分词及 how 从句
grammarSupplements.text: comparing how people respond to different expressions of regret,
grammarSupplements.explanation: comparing 作 studies 后置定语；how people respond ... 是 comparing 的宾语从句，to different expressions ... 是 respond 的介词补足语。

grammarSupplements.text: is not the number of times a speaker says sorry but whether the speaker acknowledges the harm caused and offers to repair it.
grammarSupplements.explanation: is 是主句谓语，not...but... 对比排除式表语结构。

grammarSupplements.text: a speaker says sorry
grammarSupplements.explanation: 此小句修饰 times，省略关系副词或关系词语境；speaker 为主语，says 为谓语，sorry 为所说内容。

grammarSupplements.text: whether the speaker acknowledges the harm caused and offers to repair it.
grammarSupplements.explanation: whether 引出真正决定道歉是否可信的内容，speaker 为主语，acknowledges 与 offers 并列。

grammarSupplements.text: the harm caused
grammarSupplements.explanation: caused 为过去分词后置定语，相当于 the harm that was caused，修饰 harm。

grammarSupplements.text: to repair it.
grammarSupplements.explanation: to repair 补足 offers，it 指造成的伤害；不是主句谓语。

bundledCorrections.title: 自动化判断与条件陷阱
bundledCorrections.sentence: Even if an automated system produces answers that appear more consistent than those of human reviewers, the decisions it makes should not be considered fair unless the assumptions built into its training data and the people most affected by its errors are examined together.

targets.x: Even if an automated system produces answers that appear more consistent than those of human reviewers,
targets.m: that appear more consistent than those of human reviewers,

bundledCorrections.main: the decisions it makes should not be considered fair unless the assumptions and affected people are examined together.
bundledCorrections.meaning: 即使自动化系统给出的答案看起来比人工审核者更加一致，如果不同时审查训练数据中隐含的假设以及最受错误影响的人群，它所作出的决定就不应该被认为是公平的。
distractors: 只要自动化系统的回答比人工审核更一致，它作出的决定就必然公平。
只需要检查训练数据中包含的假设，无须考虑系统错误影响最严重的人。
只有当系统的所有回答完全一致时，才可以开始考虑其公平性。
bundledCorrections.analysis: Even if 是让步条件状语从句，内部 that appear... 修饰 answers，than those of human reviewers 中 those 代替 answers，避免重复。主句 the decisions it makes 作主语，it makes 为省略关系代词的定语从句。should not be considered 是情态动词加被动式的否定谓语，fair 说明 decisions 被认定的性质，属于被动结构的主语补足语/表语，而非宾语。unless 另加“除非”条件从句；assumptions built into its training data 与 people most affected by its errors 并列作 are examined 的主语，两处过去分词均为后置修饰。

roleExplanations.v: should not be considered 为完整情态被动否定谓语，不能只圈 considered；produces、appear、makes、are examined 均属于从句。
roleExplanations.s: the decisions it makes 为主句主语，it makes 是省略 that/which 的定语从句，it 指系统。
roleExplanations.p: fair 是说明 decisions 是否应被视为公平的主语补足语/表语，不是被 considered 的直接宾语。
roleExplanations.x: Even if... 是即使如此也不能保证公平的让步条件背景；并不等于 unless 的必须满足条件。
roleExplanations.m: that appear more consistent than those of human reviewers 修饰 answers；those 代替 answers，of human reviewers 指人工审核者给出的答案。
roleExplanations.n: built into its training data 是过去分词后置定语，修饰 assumptions，说明假设嵌入在哪里。

grammarSupplements.text: Even if an automated system produces answers that appear more consistent than those of human reviewers,
grammarSupplements.explanation: even if 是即使，不保证后果成立；system 为从句主语，produces 为谓语，answers 为宾语。

grammarSupplements.text: that appear more consistent than those of human reviewers,
grammarSupplements.explanation: that 指 answers，appear 为系动词，more consistent 为表语，than those... 是比较对象。

grammarSupplements.kind: 省略关系词的主语名词组
grammarSupplements.text: the decisions it makes
grammarSupplements.explanation: decisions 是主句主语中心，it makes 修饰 decisions，省略在从句中作 makes 宾语的 that/which。

grammarSupplements.text: should not be considered fair
grammarSupplements.explanation: should not + be considered 组成被动谓语，fair 是主语补足语，否定的是认为公平这一评价。

grammarSupplements.text: unless the assumptions built into its training data and the people most affected by its errors are examined together.
grammarSupplements.explanation: unless 表除非，含义是：需要同时考察数据前提及受影响群体才能谈公平；assumptions and people 为并列主语，are examined 为被动谓语。

grammarSupplements.text: built into its training data
grammarSupplements.explanation: built 是过去分词修饰 assumptions；into 说明嵌入的位置，its 指自动化系统。

grammarSupplements.text: most affected by its errors
grammarSupplements.explanation: affected 是过去分词修饰 people；most 表程度，by its errors 引出造成影响的因素。

x: unless the assumptions built into its training data and the people most affected by its errors are examined together.

bundledCorrections.title: 科研结果中的多层嵌套与同位语
bundledCorrections.sentence: The scientists found that the organisms, which had been thought to survive only in relatively warm water, could remain active at temperatures once considered too low for life, a discovery that forced them to reconsider how adaptable the species might be.

targets.o: that the organisms, which had been thought to survive only in relatively warm water, could remain active at temperatures once considered too low for life,
targets.m: which had been thought to survive only in relatively warm water,
targets.n: once considered too low for life,
targets.r: at temperatures once considered too low for life,

bundledCorrections.main: The scientists found that the organisms could remain active at unexpectedly low temperatures.
bundledCorrections.meaning: 科学家发现，这些原先被认为只能在相对温暖的水中生存的生物，在过去被认定低到不足以维持生命的温度下仍能保持活跃；这一发现迫使他们重新思考该物种究竟有多强的适应能力。
distractors: 科学家发现这些生物只能在温水中保持活跃，因此进一步证实了原有理论。
科学家确定，这些生物一旦遇到低温就不可能存活，无需修改原有解释。
科学家认为该物种的适应能力与温度无关，因此结束了相关研究。
bundledCorrections.analysis: 主句 The scientists found 后接 that 宾语从句。宾语从句主语 the organisms 后插入 which 非限制性定语从句，which had been thought to survive ... 属过去完成时被动＋不定式补足语。跳过插入后主干为 organisms could remain active at temperatures；once considered too low for life 是过去分词结构修饰 temperatures，too low for life 是被认为的性质。逗号后 a discovery... 是概括整个发现的同位语性名词结构，that forced them to reconsider ... 修饰 discovery；them 为 forced 的宾语，to reconsider 为宾补，how adaptable ... 作 reconsider 的宾语从句。

roleExplanations.v: found 是外层主句谓语，had been thought、could remain、forced、might be 都在内部从句或后置说明里。
roleExplanations.s: The scientists 是外层主句主语，the organisms 仅为宾语从句内主语。
roleExplanations.o: that the organisms ... could remain active ... 是 found 的宾语从句，包含对 organisms 的插入修饰和温度短语。
roleExplanations.m: which had been thought to survive only in relatively warm water 为非限制性定语从句，修饰 organisms；which 作被动谓语主语。
roleExplanations.n: once considered too low for life 是修饰 temperatures 的过去分词短语，其中 considered 是非谓语核心；选 considered 或完整 once considered too low for life 都可以。
roleExplanations.r: at temperatures ... 是 remain active 的温度状语，at 说明活跃时的温度条件，temperatures 为介词宾语。

grammarSupplements.text: The scientists found that the organisms,
grammarSupplements.explanation: scientists 为主语，found 为谓语，that 引出所发现的内容；从句的主语 organisms 后有插入定语。

grammarSupplements.kind: 插入非限制性定语从句
grammarSupplements.text: which had been thought to survive only in relatively warm water,
grammarSupplements.explanation: which 指 organisms，had been thought 是过去完成时被动语态，to survive 补足 thought；in relatively warm water 说明此前认为的生存环境。

grammarSupplements.kind: that 宾语从句核心谓语
grammarSupplements.text: could remain active at temperatures once considered too low for life,
grammarSupplements.explanation: could remain 系动词组合，active 为表语，at temperatures... 为温度状语；不应把插入从句里的 thought 当成真正发现。

grammarSupplements.text: once considered too low for life,
grammarSupplements.explanation: once 为以前/曾经，considered 为过去分词修饰 temperatures，too low for life 表被认为的状态。

grammarSupplements.kind: a discovery 概括性同位语
grammarSupplements.text: a discovery that forced them to reconsider how adaptable the species might be.
grammarSupplements.explanation: a discovery 概括前面整个科研发现，不是 temperatures 的宾语；that forced... 是修饰 discovery 的定语从句。

grammarSupplements.text: forced them to reconsider
grammarSupplements.explanation: forced 是定语从句谓语，them 是宾语，to reconsider 是宾补，说明迫使研究者去做什么。

grammarSupplements.text: how adaptable the species might be.
grammarSupplements.explanation: how adaptable ... 是 reconsider 的宾语从句；species 为主语，might be 为系动词，adaptable 为表语，how 表程度。

m: that forced them to reconsider how adaptable the species might be.

bundledCorrections.title: 研究透明性与虚拟语气
bundledCorrections.sentence: Having discovered that the evidence cited in support of the policy was drawn mainly from unusually successful cases, the reviewers recommended that the results be published alongside the failures, so that readers could judge how much confidence the overall conclusion deserved.

targets.o: that the results be published alongside the failures,
targets.n: Having discovered that the evidence cited in support of the policy was drawn mainly from unusually successful cases,
targets.x: so that readers could judge how much confidence the overall conclusion deserved.

bundledCorrections.main: the reviewers recommended that the results be published alongside the failures.
bundledCorrections.meaning: 评审人员发现，支持该政策的证据主要来自异常成功的个案，因此建议在公布结果时也一同公布失败案例，以便读者判断整体结论究竟有多可信。
distractors: 评审人员发现证据覆盖了所有成功和失败案例，因此认为只公开成功结果即可。
评审人员要求只发布政策的成功数据，避免读者质疑整体结论。
评审人员认为，只要个别案例非常成功，整体结论就必然值得完全信任。
bundledCorrections.analysis: 句首 Having discovered 是完成式分词状语，逻辑主语须与主句 the reviewers 一致。它后的 that the evidence... 是 discovered 的宾语从句，其中 cited in support... 为过去分词后置定语修饰 evidence，in support of 表支持/为……提供依据；was drawn mainly from... 为从句被动谓语，from 引出数据来源。主句 recommended 后 that the results be published ... 为宾语从句，recommend 表建议时此处 be 是虚拟语气动词原形（不写 are），be published 为被动。alongside the failures 是与失败案例一同公开的介词短语。so that 引出目的从句，how much confidence ... 为 judge 的宾语从句，deserved 为该从句谓语。

roleExplanations.v: recommended 是外层主句谓语；discovered 是分词完成式中的非限定性动词，was drawn 为其内部宾语从句的谓语。
roleExplanations.s: the reviewers 是主句主语，也为 Having discovered 的逻辑主语，不可误把 evidence 当成主句主语。
roleExplanations.o: that the results be published alongside the failures 整体是 recommended 的宾语从句；be published 为建议语气的被动结构。
roleExplanations.n: Having discovered ... 为完成式分词原因/先时状语，显示先发现偏差再提出公开建议。
roleExplanations.x: so that readers could judge ... 为目的状语从句，readers 是主语，could judge 是谓语，how much confidence... 作宾语。
roleExplanations.r: in support of the policy 修饰 cited 的引用目的/对象；in support of 表为支持某政策，并非对结果的主句状语。

grammarSupplements.text: Having discovered that the evidence cited in support of the policy was drawn mainly from unusually successful cases,
grammarSupplements.explanation: Having discovered 表先前发现，用于说明提出建议的原因/背景；逻辑主语与 reviewers 一致。

grammarSupplements.text: that the evidence cited in support of the policy was drawn mainly from unusually successful cases,
grammarSupplements.explanation: the evidence 为内层主语，was drawn 为被动谓语；mainly from ... 说明来源主要偏向异常成功个案。

grammarSupplements.text: cited in support of the policy
grammarSupplements.explanation: cited 修饰 evidence，相当于 evidence that was cited；in support of 表证据引用的用途，为支持某政策。

grammarSupplements.text: the reviewers recommended
grammarSupplements.explanation: reviewers 是主句主语，recommended 为谓语；后面的 that 从句是建议的内容。

grammarSupplements.text: that the results be published alongside the failures,
grammarSupplements.explanation: recommend that ... (should) do 可省略 should；主语 the results 后直接用动词原形 be，be published 是被动语态。

grammarSupplements.text: alongside the failures,
grammarSupplements.explanation: alongside = 与……一起，the failures 为介词宾语，说明结果与失败案例应一同发布。

grammarSupplements.kind: so that 目的状语从句
grammarSupplements.text: so that readers could judge how much confidence the overall conclusion deserved.
grammarSupplements.explanation: so that 表为了，readers 是主语，could judge 为谓语，how much confidence... 为宾语从句。

grammarSupplements.text: how much confidence the overall conclusion deserved.
grammarSupplements.explanation: how much confidence 为 deserved 的宾语，the overall conclusion 为从句主语，deserved 为谓语，说明总体结论值得多少信任。

n: cited in support of the policy

bundledCorrections.title: 科技缩小距离却扩大差距
bundledCorrections.sentence: The same tools that enable students in remote communities to attend lessons delivered hundreds of kilometres away can reinforce inequalities that their developers had intended to remove if they are designed without input from those students.

targets.o: inequalities that their developers had intended to remove
targets.m: that enable students in remote communities to attend lessons delivered hundreds of kilometres away
targets.x: if they are designed without input from those students.

bundledCorrections.main: The same tools can reinforce inequalities if they are designed without student input.
bundledCorrections.meaning: 让偏远社区学生能够参与数百公里外课程的同一批工具，如果在设计时没有听取这些学生的意见，反而可能加剧开发者原本打算消除的不平等。
distractors: 这些工具能够把远方课程送到偏远地区，因此设计时不需要学生参与也必然缩小差距。
开发者原先就是为了扩大不平等而设计这些工具，并且已经实现目标。
只要学生能上远程课程，技术设计中出现的其他不平等就不会产生影响。
bundledCorrections.analysis: 主句主语 The same tools 后是很长的 that 定语从句，enable sb to do sth：students 为宾语、to attend 为宾补；lessons 后 delivered... 是过去分词后置定语。跳过后续修饰才能看到主句谓语 can reinforce 与宾语 inequalities。宾语后的 that their developers had intended to remove 修饰 inequalities，that 在从句中为 remove 的宾语，而 had intended to remove 中 to remove 为 intended 的不定式补足语。if... 为条件状语从句，they 指 tools，are designed 是被动谓语；without input from those students 为介词短语，without 的宾语 input，from those students 进一步修饰 input。

roleExplanations.v: can reinforce 是主句情态动词＋动词原形的谓语；enable 与 intended 分别在不同定语从句中，are designed 在 if 从句中。
roleExplanations.s: The same tools 是主句主语，that ... away 是修饰 tools 的定语从句，students 是该从句内 enable 的宾语。
